name: Creamy Scallop Orzo Pasta with Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Jalapeño

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ½-cup pasta water before draining.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g orzo pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
3 red bell peppers
3 jalapeño peppers

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice zucchini. Place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, halve, and mince onion; peel and mince garlic Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 ½ tsp paprika
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pat the scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sea scallops
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, add scallops and cream to the pot, then gently stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until scallops are opaque, 5-6 minutes.

Add cooked orzo to the pot and stir to combine. Add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency. Continue to cook until orzo is warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide the creamy scallop and pasta sauté between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
